extDescription.message: Upscale images right on the page. Runs locally — your images are never uploaded.

menuEnhancePage.message: Upscale all images on this page

errAlreadyRunning.message: This image is already being processed.

errNotLoaded.message: The image hasn't loaded yet. Try again.

errTainted.message: The site blocks access to this image, and downloading it directly didn't work either.

errDecode.message: Couldn't read this image — the file may be damaged.

errVector.message: This is a vector image: it already renders sharply at any size.

errTooLarge.message: This image is too large — processing wouldn't fit in memory.

errOutOfMemory.message: Out of memory. Try the "fast" level in settings.

errImageNotFound.message: Couldn't find that image on the page.

errAlreadyBigEnough.message: This image is already the target size — nothing to do.

errRefineNoOp.message: Nothing to improve with: sharpening is off and the selected network adds no detail. Raise the sharpness, or pick Real-ESRGAN or the detailed model in settings.

errRefineTooLarge.message: This image is too large for the selected model on this device, and sharpening is off. Raise the sharpness in settings — it works at any size.

pageBusy.message: This page is already being processed.

pageAllBigEnough.message: All images are already the target size.

pageBatchTrimmed.message: Too many images for one run. Took the first $TAKEN$, skipped $SKIPPED$.

popupNote.message: "Upscale" changes the size, "Quality" keeps it. For a single image, hover over it or use the right-click menu.

levelAutoHint.message: The extension picks a level based on your device.

levelFastHint.message: Browser-native scaling. A few milliseconds, softer result. Good for slow machines and very large images.

levelBalancedHint.message: Lanczos filter. The neural network runs only when WebGPU is available — otherwise it would be too slow for this level.

levelQualityHint.message: Neural network wherever it applies, otherwise a wider Lanczos filter. Without WebGPU this takes seconds.

modelRealHint.message: 2.4 MB of weights, upscales fourfold in one pass. It differs from the others not in architecture but in training: the others only ever saw clean downscaled copies, while this one saw simulated real-world degradation — compression, noise and blur. Measured on the reference test: the most accurate of them all (error 5.7 against 6.3 for the detailed model) and four times cheaper in time. In exchange it adds less texture than the detailed model.

modelSlimHint.message: 0.9 MB of weights. Fast: about 0.1 s for a 600×400 image on WebGPU. Moderate improvement.

modelMediumHint.message: 2.7 MB of weights, roughly three times deeper. Measurements show little difference from the light model: both run into the same training objective.

modelDetailedHint.message: 4.5 MB of weights, 477 layers, upscales fourfold in one pass. GAN-trained: it synthesises texture instead of smoothing, so there is far less blur. In exchange it is the slowest of them all (four times dearer than Real-ESRGAN), its image size limit is correspondingly lower, and some fine detail is invented rather than recovered. Not recommended without WebGPU.

mlStrengthHint.message: The detailed model was trained on clean images, so on compressed photos it mistakes compression artefacts for texture and produces wavy smears. Lowering the strength blends in the plain filter and suppresses them. 100% means the network alone.

sharpenHint.message: Boosts brightness transitions at edges after upscaling. Unlike the neural network it invents nothing — it only emphasises what is already there. All the models deliberately leave sharpening alone. Above 60% on compressed images, light halos start to appear around high-contrast edges. For the "Quality" button with the light or medium model this is the only tool that does anything: at zero it will change nothing.

targetAutoHint.message: The factor is derived from how many pixels the image lacks on screen.

targetLongestSideHint.message: Images smaller than the target are enlarged, larger ones are shrunk. Longest side rather than width: otherwise portrait images would grow disproportionately.

optSkipIfLargeEnough.message: Leave images that already meet the target

optSkipIfLargeEnoughHint.message: If off, larger images are shrunk down to the target size.

optReplaceOnPage.message: Replace the image on the page

optReplaceOnPageHint.message: If off, the result can only be downloaded.

optVerboseLoggingHint.message: Useful for figuring out why an image wasn't processed.

privacyText.message: All processing happens on this device. Images are never uploaded, and the extension collects no analytics. Access to all sites is needed for exactly one thing: downloading an image you explicitly picked, when the page blocks access to it.
